lead_outcomes.reason: Not an opportunity: a reflection article by two UN Youth Office Youth Reference Group members about attending the 2026 ECOSOC Youth Forum ('Attending the 2026 ECOSOC Youth Forum as members of the United Nations Youth Office Reference Group was both a collective milestone and a deeply personal experience.'). It contains no call for applications.

Not a current opportunity: information page on a one-off General Assembly high-level meeting held on 25 September 2025 for the 30th anniversary of the World Programme of Action for Youth. In-person registration was only for ECOSOC-accredited NGOs and specially accredited organisations and closed long ago ('Registration for in-person participation is now open until 15 August 2025'). No individual call and no funding.

Fee and closed deadline on the organiser's page (CIPES, with The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong): a paid forum (Self Funded '$ 599 / delegate', Forum Access '$ 200 / delegate') where even the 'Fully Funded' route is listed at '$ 16.99 awarded on merit', and 'Your place is confirmed only once registration and payment are complete beforehand, including for delegates awarded funding.' Only 10 full awards (airfare support 'ranging from USD 300 to USD 1,000'). The page's deadline reads 'NOV 12' and the forum runs 17-20 December 2026, so the call is also closed. The aggregator's 'Fully Funded' title overstates it.

Pay-to-attend summit, not a fully funded one. The only registration page is an Eventbrite ticket page by 'School of Leadership and Diplomacy (SLD)' (the aggregator names a different organiser, 'Voice for Rights International (VFRI)'); it lists the FAQ items 'How much is the fee to apply?' and 'Is the application / Processing Fee refundable if I am not selected?' and states 'No refunds'. 'Fully Funded' appears only on the aggregator, which itself describes '100% waiver of the Conference fee for 10 Delegates'. Unclear organiser plus an application fee: scam screen.

Application fee on the organiser's page (Voice for Rights International, vfri.ca): 'Pay the applicable processing fee and submit your application.' It is not fully funded: only '100% Conference Fee Waiver for 20 selected delegates' with 'Partial Airfare Support in the Form of Reimbursement'; the rest are partially sponsored or self-sponsored delegates. Deadline 30 November 2026; summit 21-24 May 2027 in Vancouver. All nationalities aged 16+ may apply, so the DRC is not excluded; the fee is the problem. 'Fully Funded' appears only on the aggregator.

Pay-to-apply camp, not fully funded. AYFN Academy's own scholarship page makes applicants buy a non-refundable e-book to apply ('The title of the Ebook that you need to purchase for applying the scholarship (Japan Camp) is Travel and Global Career'; 'The Ebook product is non refundable in any circumtances.'). The best award is a program-fee waiver plus a travel grant 'up to USD 750'; the self-funded track costs 'Starts from USD 1,000'. A disguised application fee and 'fully funded' only on the aggregator: scam screen.

The organiser's site (Young Security Conference, youngsecurityconference.com) shows only the 2025/26 programme; no 2026/27 call is published there. The 2026/27 call exists only as a LinkedIn PDF and aggregator posts, which give an application deadline of 11 November 2026 (passed) and email applications to an individual's university address. Worth rechecking on the official site for the 2027/28 call; the fellowship targets early-career researchers and professionals in European security.

A paid training course, not a funded forum. The organiser (International Training Centre of the ILO, Turin; Global Youth Forum 2027, 18-29 January 2027) lists the price as Tuition €2,330 and Subsistence €1,620, Total €3,950, and offers only partial awards: ‘ITCILO scholarships of €600 EUR available to nationals of countries included in the DAC list of ODA recipients’ (scholarship applications by 20 November 2026; course deadline 3 December 2026). Even with the award the applicant would pay about €3,350 plus flights and a Schengen visa.
